relations.text: 49.9%を出資する合弁会社で、サムスンのダクトレス空調機とヒートポンプを米国とカナダで販売する
relations.text_en: Lennox owns a 49.9% interest in a joint venture that distributes Samsung ductless AC and heat pump products in the U.S. and Canada

source.label: レノックス・インターナショナル 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: We own a 49.9% interest in a joint venture with Samsung that distributes Samsung ductless AC and heat pump products in the U.S. and Canada as well as "Lennox powered by Samsung" branded products through Lennox Stores and direct-to-dealer network.
